root: ^A group of busy people finally found time to sit down for tea and chat.
^Cypsel: Hey! Long time no see, it's great that we're all still alive!
^Hirundin: The only one among us at risk of that is you, ha.
^Lin: Long time no see. I brewed some tea—roselle osmanthus black tea.
^Lin: Mm. The tea is a bit sour, good for refreshing the mind. Everyone’s been busy lately, haven’t you?
^Cypsel picked up his cup, took a sip, and quickly set it down.
^Cypsel: Dr. Lin’s tea is still way too healthy. Ah, let me start—just the other day I…
